messages:
alex: Heads-up — customer Opal wants BYOK with an on-prem HSM in SG plus a local subcontractor that can perform emergency rewraps under SLA. They asked for exact custody boundaries and RBAC.
haley: Legal flag first: SG subprocessor = cross-border consent + export-control check. We'll need signed appendix and explicit customer opt-in.
morgan: From product: we must avoid giving subprocessor raw unwrapped key material. Proposal: proxy rewrap service that spins an attested, ephemeral session on the customer's HSM. Operator submits job, proxy performs unwrap/rewrap, returns attestation + artifacts.
alex: Good. Compliance checklist: per-operation attestation, operator identity + justification, non-export of key material, digest-only in logs. Can audit pipeline store attestation blobs?
morgan: Yes — store blobs in audit-store (immutable), log digest in main audit row. Audit row fields: rewrap_id, operator_id, reason, attestation_digest, input_hash, output_hash, hsm_fw. No keys.
secbot: Suggested IAM role snippet:
- role: subprocessor.rewraper
  allow: ["rewrap:submit","rewrap:view_status"]
  deny: ["kms:exportKey","kms:listKeys","kms:importKey"]
  enforcement: ["mfa","justification_required"]
haley: Require short-lived operator certs, per-operation justification, and an explicit consent checkbox in the SOW. Also retention: some regs want 5+ years, our default is 1 year — implement per-customer retention labels routing to cold archive.
oncall-sre: Runbook question: if a rewrap fails mid-DR, what's the triage? Suggest: block more rewraps, collect attestation blobs, run reproducibility test in staging HSM, escalate to sec-oncall on attestation mismatch. Tag incident rewrap-integrity-failure.
morgan: Threats: replay of rewrap requests, forged operator calls, proxy compromise. Controls: nonce-per-request, short TTL signatures, HSM-side nonce check, monotonically increasing rewrap counter baked into attestation. SIEM should alert on duplicate nonces or counter gaps.
haley: Also require binary code-signing and runtime integrity checks for proxy. For audits, provide a chain: operator identity -> request justification -> HSM attestation.
secbot: SIEM rules added: rewrap_nonce_replay -> high; rewrap_counter_jump -> critical -> pager; rewrap_attestation_mismatch -> high -> IR case. Enforcement: all rewraps must include attestation blob or request rejected.
alex: Action items: haley -> SOW appendix + consent flow; morgan -> IAM PR for new role and tests; oncall-sre -> add runbook and schedule tabletop. Aim to demo synthetic rewrap with attestation to Opal next week.
haley: I'll loop in legal and sales. secbot: reminder - attach HW attestation to every rewrap ticket. :lock:
